[Problem]{.card-kicker} **label edges so the largest path MEX is small** [CF 1325C · Ehab and Path-etic MEXs](https://codeforces.com/problemset/problem/1325/C){rating="1500"}

On a path, some pair's route is the whole tree, so the largest MEX is $n - 1$ no matter how you label. If some vertex has degree at least $3$, three edges meet there. Put $0, 1, 2$ on three of them. Every path misses at least one of those three, because a path uses at most two edges at a vertex. The largest MEX is then $2$. For $n \ge 3$ the labels $0$ and $1$ lie on some common path, so some MEX is at least $2$, and the three labels at one vertex meet that bound.

[Solved in full in @sec-tr-p5-mex.]{.card-link}

:::
